main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 5-bar return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid cases, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with mean excess t >= 1 and >= 200 cases); slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return of the same cases, ordinary t >= 1

decided_by: Slope t between -2 and 2: inconclusive per the plan.
reading: Grid per window at positions 0,5,10,... with the 5-bar return inside the window; normal drift = mean 5-bar return over all grid cells of all the coin's windows; the plan's 'fewer than 200 cases' rule is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow's minimum-count rule.
